The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing procurement strategies that enhance operational efficiency, optimize costs, strengthen supplier relationships, and support the organization's long-term business objectives.

Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Strong analytical, organizational, and decision-making capabilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Demonstrated leadership experience in managing and developing procurement teams.
